title: The Lantern Below
synopsis: A grieving lighthouse keeper discovers a second light burning beneath the sea, calling ships toward a city that should not exist.

direction.subject: A weathered, grieving lighthouse keeper gazing down from a jagged cliff into the dark ocean.
direction.setting: A stormy, midnight coastal cliffside overlooking a turbulent sea with a submerged bioluminescent civilization visible deep below.
direction.palette: Deep navy, cold emerald green, and a piercing, warm amber-gold for the supernatural lights.
direction.composition: Wide cinematic shot with the lighthouse on the left third and the glowing underwater city in the right bottom third, creating a diagonal tension.
continuity_rules: The keeper wears a salt-stained dark peacoat
The underwater glow must be a distinct bioluminescent amber
Mist and sea spray must be present
direction.cover_prompt: A cinematic 16:9 wide shot of a lonely lighthouse on a jagged cliff at midnight; a powerful beam of white light cuts through the fog, while deep beneath the dark, churning waves, a massive, ethereal golden city glows with haunting beauty. Photorealistic, maritime horror aesthetic, 8k, highly detailed, moody lighting.
direction.thumbnail_prompt: A high-contrast 16:9 YouTube thumbnail featuring a close-up of a weathered hand holding a glowing antique brass lantern over a dark abyss. In the water below, the terrifyingly beautiful silhouette of a sunken city glows in vibrant teal and neon gold. Sharp focus, saturated colors, with the bold, stylized text 'The Lantern Below' prominently displayed.
